max_power_output.description: Maximum power limit (0.0 to 1.0) commanded to the turret CRServo. Limits maximum turret rotation speed.

ks.description: Static friction compensation power (0.0 to 1.0) added to turret rotation to overcome gear backlash and stiction. Applied in the direction of movement.

servo_direction_inverted.description: Flips which CRServo direction counts as increasing turret angle. Set this (not the analog encoder's 'inverted' flag) when the turret drives away from its target.

logo.description: Mounting orientation direction of the hub's logo panel (e.g. RIGHT, LEFT, UP, DOWN, FORWARD, BACKWARD).

usb.description: Mounting direction of the hub's USB ports.

min_angle.description: Most negative turret angle (degrees, relative to the chassis) the turret is allowed to reach.

max_angle.description: Most positive turret angle (degrees, relative to the chassis) the turret is allowed to reach.

aim_hysteresis.description: Multiplier applied to the aim tolerance to decide when the turret leaves the 'aimed' state. 1.0 disables hysteresis and makes the turret chatter on the tolerance boundary; 2.0 means it must drift to twice the tolerance before driving again.

timeout_sec.description: Seconds the turret may be actively commanded to move without measurable progress before a stiction kick is applied.

kick_power.description: Power applied once a stall is detected, in place of the normal PIDF command, to break static friction.

progress_deg.description: Angular movement that counts as 'making progress' and resets the stall timer.

max_drift.description: Maximum allowed chassis drift (inches) from target pose before auto-corrective drive motions engage.

near_cutoff.description: Distance boundary (inches) below which the target is considered close, switching to static tolerance.

near_val.description: Target alignment tolerance (degrees) when within the near cutoff range.

min_deg.description: Minimum dynamic alignment tolerance (degrees) allowed. Prevents the turret from hunting indefinitely when very close.

max_deg.description: Maximum dynamic alignment tolerance (degrees) allowed. Prevents launching if the turret orientation error exceeds this.

enabled.description: Enable/disable automatic heading lock when the driver releases the turn joystick in TeleOp.

zero_voltage.description: Analog voltage (V) corresponding to 0 degree turret angle position.

degrees_per_volt.description: Scale factor (degrees/volt) converting analog input voltage delta to turret angle in degrees.

min_voltage.description: Minimum safe voltage limit for the analog encoder.

max_voltage.description: Maximum safe voltage limit for the analog encoder.

full_scale_voltage.description: Full electrical span (volts) of the turret potentiometer, i.e. the voltage at which it wraps back to zero.

inverted.description: True if increasing turret angle produces decreasing analog voltage.

robot_width.description: Total physical width of the robot (inches) used to build the collision footprint. Determines how close the robot can get to walls or goals.

rotation_lookahead_time.description: Time horizon (seconds) used to project future rotation based on live angular velocity (|omega| * time). Seeded at 0.075s (derived from 0.45rad / assumed 6.0rad/s max omega); calibrate on robot using Friction Calibration TeleOp.

size.description: Length (inches) of one side of the square scoring goal zones on the field.

min_y.description: The Y-coordinate boundary (inches) on the field where the scoring zones begin. Used to calculate red/blue alliance goal boxes.

red_goal_x.description: Goal center X coordinate for RED alliance.

red_goal_y.description: Goal center Y coordinate for RED alliance.

blue_goal_x.description: Goal center X coordinate for BLUE alliance.

blue_goal_y.description: Goal center Y coordinate for BLUE alliance.

enable_depth_protection.description: Enable/disable depth (X-axis) goal zone proximity protection. Safety policy parameter; leave true outside of debugging.

enable_side_protection.description: Enable/disable side (Y-axis) goal zone proximity protection. Safety policy parameter; leave true outside of debugging.

power.description: Motor power (0.0 to 1.0) commanded to push the robot away when it violates a goal zone boundary. Driver/safety policy parameter.

decel_safety_factor.description: Safety margin factor (0.0 to 1.0) for predictive braking (e.g. 0.7 = 30% safety margin over physics model prediction). Risk tolerance/policy parameter.

slow_down.description: Distance (inches) from goal zone at which proximity speed reduction starts. Driver comfort / early-warning feel parameter.

hard_stop.description: Distance (inches) from goal zone where drive power towards zone is cut to zero. Safety policy parameter.

slow_down.description: Distance (inches) from goal zone at which proximity speed reduction starts. Driver comfort / early-warning feel parameter.

hard_stop.description: Distance (inches) from goal zone where drive power towards zone is cut to zero. Safety policy parameter.

lane_blend_distance.description: Distance (inches) over which safety slows downs are interpolated from 0% to 100% strength to prevent jerky speed changes.

rot.description: Minimum turn/yaw drive power (0.0 to 1.0) needed to overcome static wheel stiction. Calibrated using Friction Calibration OpMode.

time.description: Joystick input filter time constant (seconds). Higher values make acceleration and deceleration smoother but increase input lag.

back_lift_multiplier.description: Divisor scaling factor for deceleration. Divides the deceleration rate when stopping to slow down the deceleration curve, preventing the robot from tipping forward and lifting its back wheels.

enabled.description: Enable/disable automatic heading lock when the driver releases the turn joystick in TeleOp.

intent_threshold.description: Raw joystick turn threshold (0.0 to 1.0) above which driver active steering takes control and disengages heading lock.

ks_moving.description: Minimum rotational drive power (0.0 to 1.0) needed to overcome friction while the robot is already translating.

moving_speed_threshold.description: Chassis translational speed threshold (inches/sec) above which full ks_moving friction feedforward is applied.

max_power.description: Maximum motor power (0.0 to 1.0) the loop is allowed to command. Clamped to be completely imperceptible.

error_deadband_deg.description: Heading error (degrees) below which heading lock applies zero correction, to avoid chattering/jitter from sensor noise while holding a heading at rest.

settle_rate_dps.description: Rotation rate (degrees/sec) below which the robot counts as settled. Heading lock waits for this before capturing the heading to hold, so it does not latch mid-coast and fight the robot's own momentum.

max_rpm.description: Maximum rotational speed (RPM) of the motor. Used to scale power percentage to velocity.

min_transfer_threshold.description: Flywheel speed threshold (percentage, 0.0 to 1.0) required to trigger the transfer belt. Prevents launching rings before the shooter is up to speed.

max_velocity_threshold.description: Flywheel velocity upper bound scale factor (e.g. 1.05) to prevent overshooting before feeding rings.

feed_intake_power.description: Front intake power (0.0 to 1.0) when feeding rings to the shooter.

feed_transfer_power.description: Transfer motor power (0.0 to 1.0) when feeding rings to the shooter.

long_hood_power_threshold.description: Launch power ratio threshold above which the high hood position is selected for long-range shots.

low_position.description: Hood servo low/retracted position coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for short-range shots.

high_position.description: Hood servo high/extended position coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for long-range shots.

threshold_distance.description: Distance boundary (inches) separating close-range shots from long-range shots.

launch_power.description: Flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) used for close-range shots.

wait_time.description: Delay (milliseconds) to keep the flywheel running after firing a near shot.

blue_base_power.description: Base flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) for Blue alliance shots beyond the threshold distance.

red_base_power.description: Base flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) for Red alliance shots beyond the threshold distance. Red shoots from farther away so this value is intentionally higher.

power_scale.description: Distance divisor (inches) to scale up flywheel power as distance increases (power = base_power + extra_distance / power_scale).

wait_time_scale.description: Multiplier converting distance to run-time (wait_time = distance * wait_time_scale) in milliseconds.

drink_wait_ms.description: Wait delay (milliseconds) at the drink gate when intake gathers rings.

shoot_wait_ms.description: Wait time (milliseconds) allowed to fire a shot before ending the shoot command.

launch_power.description: Flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) used for close-range shots.

transfer_power.description: Target power coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for autonomous transfer motor.

opposite_drink_wait_ms.description: Wait delay (milliseconds) at the drink gate for opposite alliance autonomous.

opposite_shoot_wait_ms.description: Wait time (milliseconds) allowed to fire a shot for opposite alliance autonomous.

opposite_launch_power.description: Target power coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for opposite alliance autonomous launcher.

opposite_transfer_power.description: Target power coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for opposite alliance autonomous transfer.

max_speed.description: Maximum speed scaler (0.0 to 1.0) applied to chassis manual TeleOp drive inputs.

intake_power.description: Target motor power (0.0 to 1.0) for intake rollers in TeleOp.

transfer_power.description: Target power coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for autonomous transfer motor.

manual_rev_power.description: Target flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) for manual rev command in TeleOp.
